# Playable game — fine-tuning and follow-up fixes

## Problem statement
Follow-up work raised during review of the completed playable-game epic (AH-0MTZWZ1MQ004L552). This epic tracks six child items covering HUD labelling, transition behaviour, power-up spawn spacing, HUD lives overlap, and a new wave time-limit pressure mechanic.

## Users
- **Players**: Experience clearer level/wave progression info, better HUD layout, and increased tension from wave time limits.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. All six child work items are completed, tested, and committed to dev.
2. Level/wave transition banners are transient (~1.5–2 s) rather than persisting for the whole wave.
3. HUD displays "Level N of 5, Wave M of K" consistently across persistent indicators and transition banners.
4. Player can move and auto-fire during wave/level transition pauses (only enemy spawning blocked).
5. Power-up drops maintain minimum separation on spawn.
6. HUD lives label is never obscured by active power-up effect rows.
7. A per-wave timer bar depletes; on expiry with enemies remaining, all surviving enemies detonate at 10x scale and the player loses one life.
8. Full project test suite passes.

## Constraints
- All changes in the existing game codebase; no new external dependencies.
- Tests must be automated and run before each commit.
- Work happens in a worktree created by `implement.py start`.
- Only push to `dev` branch (never `main`).

## Existing state
- Five levels + Central AI boss game delivered in epic AH-0MTZWZ1MQ004L552.
- Main menu -> five levels -> Central AI boss -> game over flow works end-to-end.
- HUD shows level info but not progress counts.
- Transition banners persist too long.
- Player movement blocked during transitions.
- Power-up drops can overlap.
- No wave timer mechanic.

## Desired change
Each child item implements one fix or feature:

| Child | Type | Summary |
|-------|------|---------|
| AH-0MU7JTEMC006QPSN | bug | Transition banner hides within ~1.5–2 s |
| AH-0MU7JTEY3004EXR2 | task | HUD shows "Level N of 5, Wave M of K" |
| AH-0MU7JTF9W008B8HW | bug | Player can move during transition pauses |
| AH-0MU7JTFM5000R4ME | bug | Power-up drops maintain minimum separation |
| AH-0MU7JTFY1006QA8I | bug | HUD lives label never overlaps power-up rows |
| AH-0MU7JTG9R002ZWA6 | feature | Wave time-limit bar with 10x detonation penalty |

## Key Files (predicted)
- `src/scenes/PlayScene.ts` — Banner timing, transition logic, HUD wiring, timer bar
- `src/ui/HUD.ts` — Lives label + power-up row layout
- `src/waves/WaveManager.ts` — Level/wave count exposure
- `src/powerups/placement.ts` — Drop separation logic
- `src/vfx/explosionParticles.ts` — Explosion scale factor

## Related work
- Epic AH-0MTZWZ1MQ004L552 — Playable game (parent context)
- All six children discovered from that epic

## Risks & assumptions
- **Scope creep**: Wave time-limit feature is a net-new mechanic (largest scope item). Ensure it stays bounded to the described behaviour.
- **Assumption (AH-0MU7JTG9R002ZWA6)**: Timer is per-wave, resets each wave, pauses during transitions. Needs producer confirmation before implementation. `needs-producer-review: true` already set.
- **Assumption**: 30 s default timer duration (tunable). Producer to confirm.
- **Risk**: Changing transition pause behaviour (AH-0MU7JTF9W008B8HW) may expose edge cases in enemy/player collision logic.
- **Risk**: Power-up separation (AH-0MU7JTFM5000R4ME) may require significant refactoring of spawn logic if current code has no placement constraints.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers
- Q: "Wave timer scope — per wave or per level?" — Answer (assumed): Per wave. Source: work-item description. **Status: OPEN — needs producer review** (AH-0MU7JTG9R002ZWA6 already marked `needs-producer-review: true`).
- Q: "Timer duration?" — Answer (assumed): e.g. 30 s, tunable. **Status: OPEN — needs producer review.**
- Q: "Does timer pause during transitions and game over?" — Answer (assumed): Yes. **Status: OPEN — needs producer review.**

# Player cannot move during wave/level transition pauses

## Problem
When a wave/level is cleared, PlayScene enters a transition pause and `tick()` returns early, so the player ship cannot move or auto-fire until the next wave spawns. The player should stay in control during the pause; only enemy spawning (and enemy-based collisions) should be suspended.

## Expected behaviour
- During the transition pause, player input, physics and auto-fire continue to run.
- The player cannot be hit or lose lives during the pause (no enemies/bullets spawned).
- When the pause ends, the next wave spawns normally.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Moving the ship during a transition changes its position (input honoured).
2. The ship continues to auto-fire during the transition pause.
3. No life is lost during the pause.
4. The next wave spawns and gameplay resumes after the pause.
5. Automated test asserts ship movement during a transition.

## Key files
- `src/scenes/PlayScene.ts` (`tick`, transition branch, `_onTransitionComplete`)

data.comment: Design note: restructured PlayScene.tick() so the transition pause no longer returns early. During a transition, enemy movement/fire and _handleCollisions() are suspended, but the player block (input -> setInput -> physicsTick -> autoFire), _advanceBullets, _updateInvulnerability and _updateDrops all keep running. This honours movement + auto-fire during the pause while guaranteeing no life is lost (collisions are skipped). Added 4 regression tests in PlayScene.test.ts covering movement (AC1/AC5), auto-fire (AC2), no life loss with an enemy bullet parked on the ship (AC3), and wave resumption (AC4).
